description: Header file defining classes and structures for front panel control in a plugin, including BlinkInfo, CFrontPanel, and FrontPanelHelper, with methods for LED control, brightness, and preferences.

classes.name: BlinkInfo
classes.description: Class representing blinking information associated with a front panel, including timing and comparison operators.

classes.name: CFrontPanel
classes.description: Main class managing front panel operations such as LED control, brightness, preferences, and event observers.

classes.name: FrontPanelHelper
classes.description: Helper class providing auxiliary functions for front panel operations, such as remote LED state control.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of CFrontPanel.

methods.name: addEventObserver
methods.description: Adds an observer for front panel events.

methods.name: removeEventObserver
methods.description: Removes an observer for front panel events.

methods.name: setBrightness
methods.description: Sets the brightness level of the front panel.

methods.name: powerOffLed
methods.description: Turns off a specified LED indicator.

methods.name: powerOnLed
methods.description: Turns on a specified LED indicator.

methods.name: getPreferences
methods.description: Retrieves current preferences as a JsonObject.

methods.name: setLED
methods.description: Sets LED state based on blink info.

methods.name: setBlink
methods.description: Configures blinking behavior based on blink info.

methods.name: is24HourClock
methods.description: Checks if 24-hour clock mode is active.

methods.name: setRemoteLedState
methods.description: Sets the remote LED state (helper function).
